<span class="r-help-subtitle">Scientific Programmer — Biodiversity Data, R Packages, Open Science</span>

<span class="r-help-section">Description:</span>

     Scientific programmer at <a href="https://www.idiv.de/en/groups-and-people/core-groups/synthesis.html" class="r-link">iDiv</a>, working in
     <a href="https://www.idiv.de/en/groups-and-people/core-groups/synthesis.html" class="r-link">Jonathan Chase's Biodiversity Synthesis group</a>.
     Builds reproducible data pipelines, standardises ecological datasets,
     and writes R packages — then tells everyone how great <span class="r-inline">'renv'</span> is.

<span class="r-help-section">Details:</span>

     Day to day: extract, restructure, and quality-check biodiversity data
     from the literature; assist colleagues with R problems; build research
     compendia in documented, reproducible environments. Writes a monthly
     tech newsletter for the group.

     Other activities: co-maintains <span class="r-inline">'parzer'</span>, <span class="r-inline">'rgnparser'</span>, <span class="r-inline">'subtools'</span>
     with rOpenSci and CRAN. Weekend projects that became CRAN packages:
     <span class="r-inline">'APMD'</span> (analog photo EXIF metadata) and <span class="r-inline">'stopmotion'</span> (assembles
     image sequences into animations in R).

<span class="r-help-section">See Also:</span>

     <a href="blog.html" class="r-link">blog</a>, <a href="cv.html" class="r-link">cv</a>, <a href="#r-contact" class="r-link">contact</a></pre>
